note: Coordinates are approximate (to about 100 m). Sources are given only where the claim comes from a UNESCO World Heritage listing.

places.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
places.blurb: Historic royal palace square in central Kathmandu (Hanuman Dhoka).
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Patan Durbar Square
places.blurb: Newar palace complex with temples, courtyards and richly carved woodwork.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
places.blurb: Medieval Newar city square with brick-and-timber architecture.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Swayambhunath
places.blurb: Hilltop stupa complex overlooking the Kathmandu Valley; a Buddhist site also visited by Hindus.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Boudhanath Stupa
places.blurb: Large stupa and centre of Tibetan Buddhism. Walk clockwise around it.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Pashupatinath
places.blurb: Hindu temple complex on the Bagmati River. Parts are open only to Hindus; be respectful near the ghats.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Changu Narayan
places.blurb: Hilltop Hindu temple complex east of Bhaktapur.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

places.name: Garden of Dreams
places.blurb: A walled neoclassical-style garden near Thamel, a quiet break from the busy streets.

places.name: Thamel
places.blurb: Busy visitor district of shops, cafes and trekking-gear sellers.

places.name: Asan Bazaar
places.blurb: Traditional market crossroads in old Kathmandu selling everyday goods, spices and produce.

places.name: Juju dhau (king curd), Bhaktapur
places.blurb: Bhaktapur is known for juju dhau, a creamy sweet curd. Ask around the square for sellers.

places.name: Nagarkot
places.blurb: Hill-top village east of the valley, popular for sunrise and mountain views when skies are clear.

places.name: Narayanhiti Palace Museum
places.blurb: Former royal palace in central Kathmandu, now a museum about the monarchy's final decades.

places.name: Kirtipur
places.blurb: Hilltop Newar town southwest of Kathmandu with quiet lanes, temples and valley views.

places.name: Khokana
places.blurb: Small traditional Newar village known for its mustard-oil pressing and red-brick lanes.

places.name: Kopan Monastery
places.blurb: Tibetan Buddhist monastery on a hill north of Boudhanath. Dress modestly and ask before photographing.

places.name: Pottery Square, Bhaktapur
places.blurb: Open square where potters shape and dry clay on wheels. A good place to see the craft up close.

places.name: Dhulikhel
places.blurb: Hill town east of the valley, known for sunrise views toward the Himalayan range on clear days.

places.name: Newari khaja (bara, choila), Patan
places.blurb: Newar snack plates such as bara and choila are served around Patan's old lanes. The pin marks the square, not a specific eatery.

places.name: Momo, Kathmandu
places.blurb: Steamed or fried dumplings are sold across the city. The pin marks the Thamel area, not a specific shop.

places.name: Dal bhat
places.blurb: Nepal's everyday meal of lentil soup, rice and sides, usually refilled on request. The pin marks the Asan area, not a specific restaurant.

places.name: Lakeside, Pokhara
places.blurb: Pokhara's lakefront strip of cafes, craft shops and trekking outfitters.

places.name: Phewa Lake
places.blurb: Large freshwater lake in Pokhara; rowing boats cross to the Tal Barahi temple island.

places.name: World Peace Pagoda, Pokhara
places.blurb: White hilltop stupa above Phewa Lake with views of the lake and the Annapurna range.

places.name: Bindhyabasini Temple, Pokhara
places.blurb: Hindu temple in Pokhara's old bazaar area dedicated to the goddess Bindhyabasini.

places.name: Lumbini (Maya Devi Temple)
places.blurb: Birthplace of the Buddha according to Buddhist tradition, with a sacred garden, monasteries and ruins.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Lumbini, the Birthplace of the Lord Buddha

places.name: Chitwan National Park (Sauraha)
places.blurb: Lowland jungle and grassland reserve in the Terai known for wildlife. Visit with a licensed guide.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Chitwan National Park

places.name: Bandipur
places.blurb: Hilltop Newar bazaar town with car-free streets, old shopfronts and mountain views.

places.name: Janaki Mandir, Janakpur
places.blurb: Large white temple in Janakpur dedicated to Sita; central to the Vivah Panchami festival.

places.name: Namche Bazaar
places.blurb: Sherpa market town and the usual acclimatisation stop on the way to Everest Base Camp.
places.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Sagarmatha National Park

places.name: Tansen (Palpa)
places.blurb: Hill town in Palpa known for dhaka topi and dhaka cloth weaving and for its old bazaar.

places.name: Ilam tea gardens
places.blurb: Rolling tea estates in far-eastern Nepal. Ilam tea is widely sold across the country.
